question_text: Choose the correct heading for: Paragraph A
options: The areas and artefacts within the pyramid itself
A difficult task for those involved
An idea for changing the design of burial structures
A single certainty among other less definite facts
explanation:
Reading Passage 2 has seven paragraphs, A-G.
Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below.
passage_text: The Step Pyramid of Djoser A The pyramids are the most famous monuments of ancient Egypt and still hold enormous interest for people in the present day. These grand, impressive tributes to the memory of the Egyptian kings have become linked with the country even though other cultures, such as the Chinese and Mayan, also built pyramids. The evolution of the pyramid form has been written and argued about for centuries.
